greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
psalm_response: INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uhamba kwindlela emnyama, mhlawumbi ebusuku, apho indlela ingacacanga kwaye unxunguphale. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyithanda kakhulu indlela izinto ezisebenza ngayo—wayengumfana owayejonga kwiinkqubo ze-cloud infrastructure, ebala imigama, kwaye ecinga ngendlela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ingabhabha ngayo kude. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona izinto abanye ababengaziboni. Kodwa namhlanje, njengoko sikhumbula uSaint Martin waseTours, umntu owayesazi ukuba ukholo lwenyani alukho kwizinto ezinkulu, kodwa kukuba nentliziyo evulekileyo kwabo basweleyo, sikhunjuzwa ngento enye ebalulekileyo: ubomi bethu abuxhomekekanga kwizinto esizenzayo, kodwa kwindlela esivuma ngayo ukuba uThixo usikhokela kwiindlela ezilungileyo.

KwiNcwadi kaTitus namhlanje, sifunda amazwi asikhumbuza indlela yokuphila: 'Kodwa xa kwabonakala ububele nothando lukaThixo, uMsindisi wethu... wasisindisa, kungekhona ngenxa yemisebenzi yobulungisa esayenzayo, kodwa ngenxa yenceba yakhe.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos uthetha ngobabalo oluvela kuThixo olusifundisayo ukuba siphile ngokuzeyisa nangokunyaniseka. UBen wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo enkulu, kodwa owayehlala enentliziyo ethembekileyo, owayehlonipha abazali bakhe, kwaye owayehlala elungele ukunika ngaphandle kokubala. Wayengumfana owayengaziboni njengomntu omkhulu, kodwa njengomntwana kaThixo owayefuna ukwenza okulungileyo.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje ngaphambi kokuba siye phambili. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, sibona amadoda alishumi anesikhumba esinegqaka, ecela inceba kuYesu. UYesu uyabaphilisa, kodwa ngomnye kuphela obuyayo ukuzokumbulela. UYesu ubuza: 'Abalishumi abahlambulukileyo, abanye abalithoba baphina?' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu akabuzi ngenxa yokuba efuna ukudumisa okanye ukubulelwa. Ubuza ngenxa yokuba uyazi ukuba umbulelo uvula intliziyo yethu kuThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayeyazi le nto. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, waxelela abazali bakhe ukuba wayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu ngaphandle kokucingela yena. Oku kukunika okungenamkhawulo, oku kuthando olungaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi. UBen wayengumntu owayebulela ngayo yonke into, owayehleka kwaye emomotheka, owayesazi ukuba ubomi sisipho esivela kuThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenengqondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam, Yesu Kristu, ndikholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenyani kule Sacrament eNgcwele. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ukhona, ndimanyene nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isigcine, kwaye isikhokelele kuxolo lwayo ngonaphakade. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabanye bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abazilileyo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Sithandwa: Bakhumbuze ukuba bathobele abalawuli nabagunyazisi, ukuba babe lulwalwa, babe nokulungela umsebenzi wonke olungileyo. Mabanganyelisi mntu, babe noxolo, babe nengqondo, bebonisa ubulali bonke kubantu bonke. Kuba nathi ngaphambili besisisidenge, singalaleli, silahlekile, sikhonza iinkanuko nezinto ezininzi ezikholisayo, siphila ngomonakalo nangomona, sithiyana, sithiyana omnye nomnye. Kodwa xa kwabonakala ububele nothando lukaThixo uMsindisi wethu, kungekhona ngenxa yemisebenzi yobulungisa esayenzayo, kodwa ngenxa yenceba yakhe, wasisindisa ngokuhlamba kokuzalwa ngokutsha nangokuhlaziywa nguMoya oyiNgcwele, awawuthululela kuthi ngobuninzi ngoYesu Kristu uMsindisi wethu, ukuze sigwetyelwe ngobabalo lwakhe, sibe ngendlalifa ngethemba lobomi obungunaphakade.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo. Emadlelweni aluhlaza indinika ukuphumla; ecaleni kwamanzi okuphumla indikhokela; iyawuvuselela umphefumlo wam. Indikhokela ezindleleni ezilungileyo ngenxa yegama layo. Nokuba ndihamba entilini yethunzi lokufa, andoyiki bubi; kuba unam, intonga yakho nenkongozelo yakho ziyandithuthuzela. Undilungisela itafile phambi kwabatshaba bam; uthambisa intloko yam ngeoli; indebe yam iyaphuphuma. Inene, ububele nenceba ziya kundilandela yonke imihla yobomi bam; ndiya kuhlala endlwini yeNkosi imihla yonke.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Njengoko uYesu eqhubeka nohambo lwakhe eYerusalem, wahamba phakathi kweSamariya neGalile. Xa wayengena elali, wadibana nabadikwe abalishumi. Bema kude naye, baphakamisa amazwi abo, besithi, 'Yesu, Mfundisi! Sivele imfesane!' Wathi akubabona, wathi kubo, 'Hambani nizibonakalise kubabingeleli.' Kwathi besahamba, bahlanjululwa. Omnye wabo, akubona ukuba uphilile, wabuya, edumisa uThixo ngezwi elikhulu; wawa phantsi ezinyaweni zikaYesu, wambulela. WayengumSamariya. UYesu waphendula wathi, 'Abalishumi abahlambulukileyo, abanye abalithoba baphina? Akubuyanga mntu ukuzokuzukisa uThixo ngaphandle kwalo wasezintlangeni?' Wathi kuye, 'Suka uhambe; ukholo lwakho lukusindisile.'

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
